name: Aruru
source:
Aruru is a golem at the Sanctuary of Apsu. She functions as a caretaker of the sanctuary, a moderator of meetings, and an avatar of the whole system. She is controlled by the Sanctuary's main Logic Engine.

She is primarily humanoid with a human face, but with longer limbs and greyish skin. Multiple characters comment on her uncanniness.

[From [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Aruru]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
